Purpose: Prevent agents from confusing visible evidence, user requirements, inference, and recommendations.

UserSpecified.Definition: Explicitly stated in the conversation or uploaded requirements.

Inferred.Definition: Reasonable assumption from screenshot context or common app behavior.
Inferred.Example: Status dot likely maps to running/stopped state.

Intended.Definition: Desired behavior implied by the product direction but not directly visible.

Recommended.Definition: Best-practice addition that helps implementation but was not requested or visible.
Recommended.Example: Add keyboard navigation to project cards.

RequiredUse: Every behavior in protocols/website_logic_and_functionality.cox must include an evidence level.
Every component .cox must include EvidenceSummary, VisibleStructure, and Interactions, with visible, inferred, intended, and recommended behavior clearly labeled inside those sections.
Security, persistence, runtime controls, analytics, and AI-provider metrics must not be marked Visible unless actually shown.

Allowed: Visible: The card grid uses rounded glass cards.
Inferred: Clicking a project card opens or launches the project.
Recommended: Add confirmation before destructive file operations.
Forbidden: The app definitely launches projects from the grid
